metadata.description: Infisical is the industry standard open-source platform for secrets management, giving apps, infrastructure, and AI agents secure, just-in-time access to API keys, credentials, and certificates, with automated rotation, leak scanning, and full auditability built in.

plugins.name: infisical-secret-scanner
plugins.description: Blocks Claude Code prompts that contain secrets. Scans every prompt locally with the Infisical CLI; nothing is sent to Infisical.
